seo.meta_description: Learn how to build a no-code AI study buddy chatbot in 15 minutes using Hugging Face Spaces. Perfect for students and lifelong learners who want to remember more effortlessly.
keywords: how to build AI study buddy without coding
suggestions: Add a short intro sentence in the article clarifying 'no code' means no programming knowledge required, not no setup at all.
Include a 1-sentence summary at the top of the article for better readability and SEO.
Optimize the subtitle for search by adding 'step-by-step' to align with common search intent.

_meta.fact_check_reason: Docker is not beginner-friendly — Gradio is the recommended starter option for Spaces
_meta.fact_check_removed: SDK: Select Docker (it's the most beginner-friendly option)
_meta.manual_fix_note: Rewritten from Hugging Face docs: Gradio/Docker Spaces now need a paid plan to create (old guide promised a free CPU Gradio chatbot), Static Spaces are free for everyone and serve index.html; creation form fields (name, optional license, visibility public/protected(paid)/private, SDK) and web file editing (Files tab > Add file > create new file, commit to main, auto rebuild) as documented. Removed invented UI ("Your Space is ready!" banner, starter def main(), progress bar) and the false "AI tutor that remembers/adapts" claim; the page is a plain flashcard quiz and says so. Sources: https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/spaces-overview , https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/spaces-sdks-static , https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/repositories-getting-started
